lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters are organized in vertical columns. A primary group of four high-intensity maxima forms a trapezoidal arrangement immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs. The high-luminance spots are centrally positioned within these vertical bands, establishing a grid-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running parallel to the longitudinal axis, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to deep shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-chroma yellow ellipsoidal feature is present on the mid-lateral flank. A secondary elongate organism with low-luminance dorsal and high-luminance ventral stripes is attached to the ventral-lateral region.
other_distinctive_markers: A non-biological, light-blue linear graphic (arrow) is overlaid on the image pixels, pointing towards a specific high-luminance spot posterior to the gill region.
